broker.name: ACY Securities
broker.tagline: On its own site since 2013. Its site names ASIC and FSCA. Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:5000.
broker.about: ACY Securities says it has operated since 2013. The pages checked do not name one headquarters. Account names on its site include Basic, Standard, ProZero, and Bespoke. Platforms named there include MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, and ACY Trading Platform. The site names these regulators: ASIC and FSCA. The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:5000. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.

broker.costs_note: Spreads and commissions move with the market, and they are not the same at every company in the group.

leverage.note: The account-type cards say this leverage is via the ACY Trading Platform.
ProZero benefits say flexible leverage up to 500:1. The copy-trading answer says all accounts offer leverage up to 500:1. Both figures are on the same official page.

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: Minimums differ by account. Account types page: Basic $50, Standard $100, ProZero $200. Help Center article updated 6 June 2025 also lists a bespoke account at $20,000. No single minimum is stored.
